newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-NATAL BEATS W.PROVINCE BY TWO WICKETS.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-NATAL BEATS W.PROVINCE BY TWO WICKETS.

text.p: Natal, bouncing back from a six-wicket defeat against Western Province in the first leg, won by two wickets in the decisive third leg of the Standard Bank Cup final at Kingsmead on Monday.
Chasing a testing 229 to win in gloomy and overcast conditions, Natal made 232 for eight in 43.2 overs.
Captain Dale Benkenstein scored the winning runs when he lofted the wrist-spin of Paul Adams for four over extra cover to give his side victory with 10 balls to spare.

Benkenstein was made man of the match for his unbeaten 37 from 30 balls, but Natal's victory platform was established by Doug Watson with a confident 53, pinch-hitter Pat Symcox, with a run-a-ball 40, and quickfire batting from Jonty Rhodes (31) and Erol Stewart (25).

Bowling: Pringle 9-0-58-0, Dawson 8-0-38-2, Matthews 8-2-27-1, Kallis 6-0-37-1, McMillan 8-0-30-2, Simons 3-0-25-0, Adams 1.2-0-12-1.
Result: Natal won by two wickets to clinch the Standard Bank Cup in the decisive third leg.
Man of the match: Dale Benkenstein.
